pages.title: Something in the Glass
pages.text: Discover unusual Nether materials and their interactions.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Collect ectoplasm with a bucket and follow the Soul Glass recipe. Read the native passage/ghost interactions before testing them; possession, not passing through glass, is checked. Lightspores and Nightspores interact with their matching wart growth; fossil fuel is a useful local fuel. Treat these

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: as separate native uses, not a requirement to carry every Nether material.
